title: World Bloom — Ordinary, Yet Special Us — Episode6 Eyes on the Future

meta.Event Outline: Things have been going well for Leo/need since their professional debut. One day, a change in the tree in their SEKAI brings them to a dream world—one where they never became estranged.

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_leoneed_op3
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(This essay was so difficult to write...
It really tested my knowledge of current events...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But it's apparently very common for such topics to appear on entrance exams for recommended candidates. What's the best way to prepare...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Should I just be watching and reading the news more? I'll have to ask the teachers whether there's anything else I can do when I go in for corrections during lunch.)
Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Morning, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Are you free during lunch today?
Saki was wondering if you wanted to eat together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I was hoping to see if I can get my essay corrected during lunch today...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Then, maybe next time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Again, I'm really sorry.
Especially since you invited me the other day as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I'm also sorry for inviting you on such short notice. I really am impressed by how much thought you're putting into your future.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, are you still thinking about studying social welfare in university?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I enjoy helping others, so I want to do what I can for society...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I still don't have a clear idea of which occupation I'm going to pursue.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Even then, I'm kind of jealous that you know what you want to do with your life.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Just look at me.
I only recently found something I'm interested in trying out.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, didn't you say you were writing a Miku song? How's that been going?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Not very well...
I'm struggling to figure out a good concept for it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, and don't tell Saki or Shiho yet.
I want to surprise them once I've completed at least the first chorus.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay.
I'll be looking forward to hearing what it's like.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of Shiho...
Is she joining you two for lunch today?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, she's been practicing up on the rooftop every day in preparation for her next show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. I was hoping to thank her for reserving me a seat...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do you think I'd be able to do that during another break or before morning homeroom?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'd say try in the morning.
She might end up on the move to a different classroom during the other breaks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Good point. Then, I'll try her tomorrow morning.
Thank you, Ichika.
Honami's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This university's program focuses on developing social workers...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: While this one offers a similar program, but seems to mainly have curricula for nursing and childcare.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And this university...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh, you're allowed to choose your concentration after taking the classes that interest you during your first year...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I do want to help people, but I don't know exactly how I plan on doing that yet...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Does that mean I should choose a program like this that allows me to experience a variety of fields?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, they even have an open house soon.
It's a little far away, but I might go visit their campus...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Come to think of it, what are the others going to do in the future...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho's already working as a professional musician, so I doubt she's going to pursue higher education. But Ichika and Saki probably will, right...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, I'll be studying social welfare, so the odds of us attending the same university seem low...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which means Miya Girls will be the last school we all attend together...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I suppose it's unreasonable to think that we'll be together forever since we're all pursuing different things in life...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I hope we get to create a few more memories while we're all still together.
se_event_wl_2nd_lightsound_2025_006
se_event_wl_2nd_lightsound_2025_007

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shibao...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. What's the matter?
I thought you were watching TV with Mom and the others in the living room.

rows.Speaker: Shibao
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Did they not give you enough attention? Were they too focused on the TV? Is that why you're here...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You poor boy.
Alright, come here.

rows.Speaker: Shibao
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shibao...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would it make you sad if you found out that you wouldn't be able to see Ichika and the others again...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, never mind...

rows.Speaker: Shibao
rows.Line:
*Sniff* *Sniff*
Woof.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shibao, stop...!
No chewing on the pamphlet!

rows.Speaker: Shibao
rows.Line: *Whimper*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I mean it! Stop chewing on it!
Here, let's play with one of your toys!
A few days later - After school

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The past problems from the standardized exam I tried today were so difficult to solve.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'll need to start preparing for that alongside the exam for recommended candidates.)

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Hey, do we have enough boxes?
If not, I'll go get some more!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Is anyone free to come buy more supplies with me? Around three people would be ideal!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Everyone's busy preparing for the school festival, so maybe I should head back to class and help the others.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I really wasn't expecting us to put on a mini planetarium for it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It'll be cardboard, but we're putting together our own dome. And I heard we're even making our own pinhole projector, so I'm really excited for it.
se_event_wl_2nd_lightsound_2025_004
se_event_wl_2nd_lightsound_2025_004

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is someone playing the drums...?
se_event_wl_2nd_lightsound_2025_004
se_event_wl_2nd_lightsound_2025_004

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it is the drums...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Who's playing them...?

rows.Speaker: First-Year A
rows.Line: Hmm... Using both of my hands at the same time is already really hard, but I have to use my feet on top of that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Wait, she's on the cleanup committee with me...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Huh? It's missing a crash cymbal.
Is she not going to use one?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The snare and tom drums seem to be in the right positions, but their heights and angles may need to be adjusted.)

rows.Speaker: First-Year B
rows.Line: But you're way better at it than the rest of us!

rows.Speaker: Second-Year A
rows.Line: Yeah! A band with no drummer just doesn't feel right, so we'd really appreciate it if you did this for us!

rows.Speaker: Second-Year B
rows.Line: Please! Just think of it as helping us out!

rows.Speaker: First-Year A
rows.Line: I want to give this a try since I am interested in playing the drums, but I'm really not sure if I'll be ready in time for the school festival...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I see... They're going to perform as a band during the school festival.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I saw a poster out in the corridor saying, “Calling all performers!”)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A band...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It took me so long to learn how to create steady rhythms...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Shiho scolded me so much about how I wasn't staying in time or sounded weak.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Still, it was so...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I may be overstepping here a little bit...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Excuse me. If you don't mind...
